Overview

The hidden cost of Blockchain & Digital Trust for Education & Research is never the model; it is the scaffolding — data contracts, evaluation harnesses, rollback machinery, audit evidence. We price and build that scaffolding explicitly, on SIS & registries, because that is where programs actually succeed or die. In Education & Research the constraints are structural, not cosmetic: GDPR / privacy regimes shapes what data may move, learning analytics dominates the economics, and any capability that cannot explain its own decisions will be switched off by risk committees. The architecture reflects all three from the first commit.

blocks.x: Engineering standards & stack

items: HSM key ceremonies
Key generation and rotation performed under ceremony, with the evidence auditors require.
on-chain/off-chain split
What must be tamper-evident goes on ledger; the bulk stays off it, linked and provable.
notarized audit exports
Evidence exports sealed so nobody can quietly edit last quarter's numbers.
hash-linked anchoring
Records anchored by hash so tampering is detectable — trust with a checksum.

blocks.x: Failure modes & the guards we ship
What usually goes wrong, and the specific guard in this build:

items: Key fragility
Keys rotated on ceremony with HSM custody — the compromise of one secret is never the compromise of the estate.
Ledger worship
The ledger used where tamper-evidence earns its cost — everything else stays a database with a backup.
On-chain PII
Personal data never written on-ledger — hashes and references only, verified in design review.
